summary: Applied Digital Corp. filed an 8-K/A to amend its prior 8-K regarding the satisfaction of an escrow condition (ESA Condition) for its 6.75% Senior Secured Notes due 2031. The notes were issued by subsidiary APLD ComputeCo 2 LLC in a private offering. On June 17, 2026, the issuer released funds from the escrow account to the issuer per the escrow agreement and indenture. This is a routine debt financing update, not a special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is involved.
